description: Paid receipt or invoice evidencing that an insurance premium has been paid in full, or is due at closing (RM Job Aid p.13, J-T3)
verification_description: Dollar amount on the receipt/invoice - if not found, this is not a premium receipt/invoice

amount.description: Dollar amount shown as paid or due (REQUIRED for verification)

paid_in_full.description: True if the document is a paid receipt showing the premium was already paid in full; false if it is an invoice for an amount due at closing

document_date.description: Date the receipt was issued or the invoice is dated

policy_number.description: Policy number the receipt/invoice applies to
